description: Edit a memory document by replacing one exact text match. Always pass if_version.
name: mcp__memory__memory_str_replace

if_version.description: 12-character version token from the most recent read or write.

new_str.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match.

old_str.description: Exact text to replace. Must match in exactly one place.

path.description: Path of the memory document to edit.
